subject: Call summary: fit assessment, benchmark links & quality safeguard request
messages:
From: Sergio Álvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Cole <hannah@nova-data.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Call summary: fit assessment, benchmark links & quality safeguard request

Hi Hannah — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap (actionable items first):

1) Immediate next steps we agreed:
   - We will run a focused eval against your 2000-record priority corpus (samples you shared) using two candidate model variants and return a short diff matrix by EOD Wed.
   - We'll provisionally freeze the model used for the pilot (proposed id: gptx-3-large@20270610) unless you request a different change; if you need a guaranteed immutable version we can add a contractual pin clause (see attached draft).

2) Recommended models and rationale:
   - gptx-3-large@20270610 — best balance of instruction-following + low hallucination on your dataset during preliminary runs.
   - gptx-3-medium-quant@20270512 — lower cost variant; acceptable for high-throughput classification tasks from our benchmarks.

3) Benchmarks and artifacts I shared:
   - Evaluation pack (attachments): nova_eval_pack_v1.zip — contains the prompt set, scoring rubric, and the small 2000-record sample.
   - Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3-nova-eval-pack (prompt templates, sample outputs, and a short README).

4) Quality/regression note and safeguards:
   - You flagged concern about regressions after vendor-side model version upgrades. To mitigate: we will produce a delta-diff matrix (behavioral diffs + token-level failure cases), propose a rollback ladder (how to revert to a prior model id), and offer a provisional freeze while pilot is active. If you prefer, we can escrow the model id in a doc and include a pin clause in the SOW.

5) Timeline and asks from you:
   - Please confirm the sample dataset in the Drive link and confirm whether we should include anonymized PII masking in the evaluation (we can run both masked/unmasked).
   - Let us know availability for a 30-min sync Thurs 10–12 PT to review initial diffs.

Attachments: nova_eval_pack_v1.zip (prompt sets, evaluation rubric)

Short note on procurement and legal: Monica, Karthik — I looped you because we may need a compact pinning clause and to surface any SLA language if Nova wants a version guarantee for the pilot.

Best,
Sergio
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Hannah Cole <hannah@nova-data.ai>
To: Sergio Álvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Call summary: fit assessment, benchmark links & quality safeguard request

Thanks, Sergio — helpful recap. A couple quick clarifications from my side: 

- Confirmed on the sample folder; I uploaded two additional documents: "priority_customers_2027.csv" and "policy_examples.txt". Please use the priority_customers file as the primary eval subset.

- Regressions: we had a negative delta last quarter when a hosted provider changed an internal tokenization behavior (simple lookup task error rate jumped ~8%). We want assurances how Redwood will detect and surface similar regressions early — the delta-diff matrix sounds good.

- Pinning: procurement will want a minimal clause that guarantees the pilot runs against the specified model id. If escrow is easier for now, that's fine — I can send procurement's contact after our Thurs review.

Available Thurs 11:00–11:30 PT for the sync. Please confirm invite + dial-in.

— Hannah
Head of ML Product, Nova Data
hannah@nova-data.ai

From: Sergio Álvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Call summary: fit assessment, benchmark links & quality safeguard request

Monica / Karthik — Hannah confirmed the dataset and wants the delta-diff and a provisional freeze for the pilot. Key internal ask: please prioritize a compact legal pinning clause we can hand to procurement if they request hard guarantees (attached draft: contract-pin-clause-draft.docx).

Operational plan (proposed, please comment):
- Today: run eval on the priority_customers_2027.csv subset (2k records) against both candidates (gptx-3-large@20270610 and gptx-3-medium-quant@20270512). Produce: 
   * summary scores (accuracy/precision/recall where applicable, top-3 hallucination flags),
   * delta-diff matrix (row-level examples where outputs diverge),
   * 20 short failure cases (for product + legal review).
- Wed EOD: share eval_results_stub.csv (attached) + a short slide with recommended pilot model and cost delta.
- If diffs show a regression vs their expected baseline, we will:
   1) propose the rollback ladder (switch to previous model id),
   2) if needed, enable a temporary routing policy to route Nova traffic to a dedicated pool pinned to the earlier model variant.

Notes / questions: 
- Karthik — can you confirm we have capacity to spin the provisional pinned pool for a two-week pilot if procurement asks? If not, what's the minimum notice?
- Monica — can you review the pin clause draft and flag anything that requires escalation?

Attachments: eval_results_stub.csv (placeholder for Wed output)

Thanks — will follow up after the 11:00 PT sync with Hannah.

Sergio

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Álvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Call summary: fit assessment, benchmark links & quality safeguard request

Thanks — quick replies inline: 

- Legal / Procurement: I reviewed the draft pin clause and tightened the language to avoid absolute SLAs for model fidelity; attached is a redline (contract-pin-clause-draft.docx). Procurement will likely accept a timeboxed pin (pilot window) + rollback remedies.

- Capacity: Karthik, we can bottle a small dedicated pool for two weeks with 48 hours notice. If Nova needs >2k qps we'll need an extra week. Karthik, please confirm and I'll include the note in the slide.

- Eval: Sergio, I like the proposed deliverables. Add a short section in the slide with exact eval rubric thresholds that would trigger escalation (e.g., +5% drop in accuracy or >3 critical hallucinations per 1k examples).

I'll be on the 11:00 PT call.

— Monica
Senior Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com
